state.research_notes:
Based on my search, here's a summary of concrete, recent facts about Claude model context windows and pricing (note: figures below reflect the current 2026 Anthropic lineup, which has moved past the earlier 3.x/4.0 models):

**1. Claude Sonnet 5 — new flagship mid-tier model with 1M context and introductory pricing**
Anthropic's own site states Sonnet 5 is available today at an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through August 31, 2026, then moves to standard pricing at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. It features a 1M context window as a hybrid reasoning model for real-time agents and high-volume work. Third-party trackers confirm it supports a 1M-token context window, up to 128K output tokens, and adaptive thinking turned on by default.

**2. Sonnet 5 uses a new, less token-efficient tokenizer**
A caveat worth flagging: Sonnet 5 uses an updated tokenizer that changes how the model processes text, and the same input can map to more tokens — roughly 1.0–1.35× depending on content type, similar to a change made with an earlier Opus release.

**3. Claude Haiku 4.5 — cheapest current-generation model**
Per Anthropic's official announcement, Haiku 4.5 pricing is $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, and it matches Sonnet 4's performance on coding, computer use, and agent tasks while scoring 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified. Anthropic also notes Haiku 4.5 pricing starts at $1/$5 per million tokens, with up to 90% cost savings via prompt caching and 50% savings with batch processing.

**4. Claude Opus (latest: Opus 4.8) — top-tier pricing with 1M context now standard**
Industry trackers report that Claude Opus 4.8 (API ID claude-opus-4-8), priced at $5.00/$25.00 per million tokens with a 1M-token context window, was released May 28, 2026, and that this is the same rate as the prior Opus 4.7, with a new "Fast Mode" priced at $10/$50 per million tokens — down from $30/$150 on Opus 4.7.

**5. Legacy models being phased out; overall Opus pricing has dropped significantly**
One tracker notes Haiku 3 is the cheapest Claude model ever but is being retired, with a suggested migration to Haiku 4.5 before April 19, 2026, while another highlights that Opus 4.5 and Opus 4.6 at $5/$25 are 66.7% cheaper than Opus 4 and Opus 4.1, which were priced at $15/$75, for the same token volumes.

**Flagged/unverifiable items:**
- Details about an "export controls" episode affecting other model families and specific product names like "Fable 5"/"Mythos 5" appeared in one source but could not be corroborated elsewhere — I excluded these as unreliable.
- The claim that Opus 4.7's new tokenizer "can produce up to 35% more tokens for the same text" appeared in a single third-party blog (finout.io) without an official Anthropic citation, so treat this figure with some caution.
- Multiple SEO-style pricing aggregator sites reproduced very similar numbers, which increases confidence, but the *only* fully official first-party sources I could confirm were the anthropic.com pages for Sonnet and Haiku 4.5 — I was not able to independently verify the Opus 4.8 figures directly on anthropic.com in this search pass.

# Claude Model Family: Context Windows & Pricing (2026)

*Note: This report reflects the current 2026 Anthropic lineup, which supersedes the earlier 3.x/4.0 model generations.*

## Summary Table

| Model | Context Window | Input Price (per M tokens) | Output Price (per M tokens) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Haiku 4.5** | Not specified in notes | $1 | $5 | Cheapest current-gen model; matches Sonnet 4 on coding/computer use/agent tasks; 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified |
| **Sonnet 5** | 1M tokens | $2 (intro, through Aug 31, 2026) → $3 (standard) | $10 (intro) → $15 (standard) | Up to 128K output tokens; hybrid reasoning with adaptive thinking on by default; new tokenizer (see caveat below) |
| **Opus 4.8** | 1M tokens (now standard) | $5.00 | $25.00 | Released May 28, 2026; same rate as Opus 4.7; new "Fast Mode" available |
| Opus 4.8 (Fast Mode) | 1M tokens | $10 | $50 | Down from $30/$150 on Opus 4.7 Fast Mode |

## Key Details by Model

**Haiku 4.5**
- Pricing confirmed directly on Anthropic's official site.
- Additional savings: up to 90% via prompt caching, 50% via batch processing.
- Haiku 3 (cheapest Claude model historically) is being retired; migration to Haiku 4.5 suggested before April 19, 2026.

**Sonnet 5**
- Pricing confirmed on Anthropic's official site.
- Uses an updated tokenizer that may increase token counts for the same input by roughly 1.0–1.35×, depending on content type — a caveat affecting effective cost-per-content compared to older models.

**Opus 4.8**
- Pricing and release date reported by industry/third-party trackers, not independently confirmed on anthropic.com in this research pass.
- Represents a major price drop from earlier Opus generations: Opus 4.5/4.6 ($5/$25) were already 66.7% cheaper than Opus 4/4.1 ($15/$75).
- Opus 4.8 continues the $5/$25 standard rate, with the new Fast Mode substantially cheaper than the prior generation's Fast Mode.

## Caveats & Unverified Claims

- **Opus 4.8 figures** come from third-party trackers; Anthropic's own site did not independently confirm these numbers in this search.
- **Opus 4.7 tokenizer claim** (up to 35% more tokens for same text) appeared in only one third-party source (finout.io) without official corroboration — treat with caution.
- Items regarding "export controls," "Fable 5," and "Mythos 5" could not be corroborated and have been excluded as unreliable.
- Multiple SEO/pricing-aggregator sites report consistent numbers, increasing confidence, but only the Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5 pricing pages on anthropic.com were confirmed as fully official first-party sources.
